# Requirements: Size✦Lab — Code Health & Hardening

**Defined:** 2026-07-01
**Core Value:** The app behaves identically to today, but the codebase is materially safer to change — no silent race conditions, no leaked listeners/subscriptions, oversized components decomposed, and the highest-risk component finally under test.

> Source of truth for scope: `.planning/codebase/CONCERNS.md` (audited 2026-07-01). Every v1 requirement below traces back to a catalogued concern. Refactors are behavior-preserving unless the fix is inherently a behavior fix (race conditions, dropped models).

## v1 Requirements

### Component Decomposition

- [x] **DECOMP-01**: `upload-modal` is split so no single file exceeds ~400 lines, with image processing, ruler/measurement UI, and form handling in separate components/services, and existing upload behavior unchanged
- [x] **DECOMP-02**: `attachment-edit-modal` is split so no single file exceeds ~400 lines, with attachment-point definition extracted to a dedicated service/component, and existing edit behavior unchanged
- [x] **DECOMP-03**: `attachment-preview` is split so no single file exceeds ~400 lines, with the Canvas rendering/interaction logic separated from selection state, and existing preview behavior unchanged

### Serialization Safety

- [x] **SERL-01**: `state-export.service` applies named migration functions to upgrade older serialized states to the current schema on import, instead of relying solely on version-equality gating
- [x] **SERL-02**: A documented version-deprecation policy exists (which versions are supported and how old ones are retired) recorded in-repo
- [x] **SERL-03**: All serialized states from currently-supported versions still load successfully after the migration layer lands (regression-tested)

### Dependency Structure

- [x] **DEP-01**: The `CategoryService` ↔ `IndexedDBUserModelService` circular dependency is eliminated so `CategoryService` no longer needs the lazy `Injector` workaround or `any` typing

### Race Conditions & Lifecycle

- [x] **RACE-01**: `penetration-modal` fetches state without `setTimeout` in `ngOnChanges`, using a proper RxJS lifecycle (`takeUntil` + `distinctUntilChanged`), with correct state shown on input changes
- [x] **RACE-02**: `compare-modal` computes default positions from actual laid-out dimensions via `ResizeObserver`/explicit layout signal rather than a `setTimeout` guess (the 40px POSITION_BUFFER behavior is preserved)
- [x] **RACE-03**: Ruler/dial drag in upload and edit modals uses PointerCapture (or an explicit drag-context manager) so a modal closing mid-drag cannot leave document listeners responding to unrelated drags
- [x] **RACE-04**: `image-metadata.service` category handling is case-consistent so no model is dropped from category filtering due to casing mismatch

### Subscription & Render Hygiene

- [x] **PERF-01**: `AppComponent` (and any similarly leaking components) tear down all long-lived subscriptions via a `takeUntil(destroy$)` pattern on destroy
- [x] **PERF-02**: `image-display` resize observation is consolidated/debounced (shared service) so multi-display views do not spawn redundant `ResizeObserver` work
- [x] **PERF-03**: Upload image processing (auto-crop, compression) runs off the main thread (Web Worker) with visible progress feedback, keeping the UI responsive during processing

### Test Coverage

- [x] **TEST-01**: `attachment-edit-modal` has a spec covering its core logic paths (form handling, attachment-point definition, cleanup)
- [x] **TEST-02**: Refactored `upload-modal` and `attachment-preview` have specs exercising their core logic paths (not just construction)
- [x] **TEST-03**: An integration test covers the share-link import flow (route guard → state restoration)
- [x] **TEST-04**: An integration test covers the upload → attachment-point definition → usage flow

### Frontend Security Hardening

- [x] **SEC-01**: Upload validates/sanitizes image MIME types (not only file size) and rejects non-image or spoofed files
- [x] **SEC-02**: Share-link generation is throttled client-side to prevent rapid repeated requests
- [x] **SEC-03**: In-repo documentation states that adult-content filtering is cosmetic (client-side only) and that upload size/rate limits require backend enforcement

## v2 Requirements

Deferred features (net-new, not debt). Tracked but not in this roadmap.

### User Features

- **FEAT-01**: Undo/redo for user actions (scale changes, overlay additions)
- **FEAT-02**: Search/filter in model selection
- **FEAT-03**: Import/export of custom attachment points between models
- **FEAT-04**: Concurrent-edit conflict resolution / multi-device sync

### Test Coverage

Promoted by Phase 5 (05-13), per D-15: recording these only in a per-phase deferred
section is precisely the mechanism that let each one slide across Phases 2, 3, and 4 in
turn. Each entry below is scoped to what genuinely remains uncovered, not to the whole
file, so a future reader can't re-defer it as "already covered" or over-scope it as
untouched.

- **TESTV2-01**: `indexeddb-user-model.service.ts` (414 lines) has no dedicated unit spec. Phase 5's TEST-04 integration spec (`upload-attach-use.integration.spec.ts`) exercises `saveUserModel()`/`getUserModel()` incidentally, as a side effect of proving the upload→attach→use flow — that is not a substitute for dedicated coverage. What remains uncovered: `deleteUserModel`, `updateUserModel`, `getStorageInfo`/quota handling, migration status, and the `StorageUnavailableError` path. *Provenance: deferred by Phases 2, 3, and 4 in turn; promoted to v2 by Phase 5 D-15 rather than deferred a fifth time.*
- **TESTV2-02**: `state-management.service.ts` (419 lines), the app's single `BehaviorSubject` store, has no dedicated unit spec. Phase 5's two integration specs (`share-link-import.integration.spec.ts`, `upload-attach-use.integration.spec.ts`) exercise it heavily as a side effect of their own flows. What remains uncovered: `updateOverlayScale`, `togglePanelFlip`, and `resetState` have no direct spec asserting their own contract in isolation. *Provenance: deferred by Phases 2, 3, and 4 in turn; promoted to v2 by Phase 5 D-15 rather than deferred a fifth time.*
- **TESTV2-03**: A regression test for the dropdown re-fire behavior — change the model-selector dropdown, emit on `userModels$`, assert the already-selected panel model is not silently re-set. *Provenance: offered in Phase 4 (D-04), not folded into that phase's plan, named Phase 5 as a fallback; not selected in Phase 5 either (05-CONTEXT.md `<deferred>`). Promoted to v2 by Phase 5 D-15 so it is not rediscovered as new work in Phase 6.*
- **TESTV2-04**: `attachment-canvas-renderer.service.ts`'s `render()` private helpers (`renderOverlays`, `renderPendingAttachment`, `renderAttachmentPoints`, `renderAngleIndicator`, `renderPendingNewPoint`, `renderCrosshairs` — ~450 of the file's 655 lines) remain at 41.31% statement / 37.23% branch coverage, the largest gap of all seven files Phase 5's TEST-02 audit measured. The public API (`render`, `hitTest`, `hoverTest`) is spec'd; the 3 existing `render()` tests don't pass the optional params (`pendingAttachmentPosition`, `isDefiningAttachmentPoint`, penetration/angle state) that drive most of these helpers' conditional branches. *Provenance: measured by 05-01's coverage audit; scoped out of 05-12 (TEST-02's text names only `upload-modal`/`attachment-preview`, not this file); recorded in `.planning/WINDOWS.md` (id 1) by 05-12; promoted here and the ledger entry waived by 05-13 so it is not left open against the ship gate for work now tracked durably.*
- **TESTV2-05**: `upload-image-pipeline.service.ts` sits at 57.14% branch coverage (all 7 functions called at least once). Likely gap: the worker-vs-fallback dispatch paths and specific error-path branches inside `processFile`. Lower priority than TESTV2-04. *Provenance: measured by 05-01's coverage audit as a secondary/opportunistic 05-12 target that was not picked up; recorded in `.planning/WINDOWS.md` (id 2) by 05-12; promoted here and the ledger entry waived by 05-13.*

## Out of Scope

Explicitly excluded. Documented to prevent scope creep.

| Feature | Reason |
|---------|--------|
| Undo/redo, search/filter, attachment import/export, conflict resolution | Net-new features, not debt; deferred to a future milestone (v2) |
| Share-link rate limiting (server-side) | Lives in the Cloudflare Worker/API repo, not available here |
| Server-side upload size/type enforcement | Backend-owned; frontend adds MIME sanitization (SEC-01) but cannot enforce server limits |
| Adult-content age gate (server-side) | Backend-owned; frontend filtering is cosmetic (documented via SEC-03) |
| Share-link TTL / garbage collection | Backend storage concern, outside this repo |
| Metadata lazy-loading / CDN caching / pagination | Backend/infra scaling concern; not triggered at current model counts |
| IndexedDB cleanup UI / cloud sync | Storage-capacity scaling feature, not a current defect |
| Behavior/UX changes | Milestone is behavior-preserving except for race-condition/dropped-model fixes |
